mutations.name: schedule-count-bypass
mutations.needle: if schedule.count .left = leftLength ∧ schedule.count .right = rightLength then .ok ⟨⟩

mutations.name: reintroduce-overlap-rejection
mutations.needle:
let _ ← (checkSchedule left.length right.length schedule).mapError .schedule
  return (lf, rf)

mutations.name: stale-initial-world
mutations.needle:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) m.world
mutations.replacement:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) ((m.attempts.head?.map (fun attempt ↦ attempt.before)).getD m.world)

mutations.name: isolated-branch-world
mutations.needle:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) m.world
mutations.replacement:
let isolated := Parallel.runBranch cfg (boundaries b) ((m.attempts.head?.map (fun attempt ↦ attempt.before)).getD m.world)
        ((selectBranch left right b).take own.consumed)
      let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) isolated.world

mutations.name: global-cancellation
mutations.needle:
let own := m.local b
  match own.failure with
mutations.replacement:
let own := m.local b
  if m.left.failure.isSome || m.right.failure.isSome then m.skip b else
  match own.failure with

mutations.name: prefix-world-rollback
mutations.replacement: | .error reason => { m.refuse b inv reason with world := ((m.attempts.head?.map (fun attempt ↦ attempt.before)).getD m.world) }

mutations.name: retry-halted-suffix
mutations.replacement: match (none : Option (LocatedFailure P A D)) with

mutations.name: peer-history-leakage
mutations.needle:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) m.world
mutations.replacement:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex
        (own.outputs ++ (m.local (match b with | .left => .right | .right => .left)).outputs)
        (.invoke inv) m.world

mutations.name: snapshot-recomputation
mutations.needle:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) m.world
mutations.replacement:
let refreshed := own.outputs.map fun observation ↦
        match cfg.catalog.find? (fun component ↦ decide (component.id = observation.port.component)) with
        | none => observation
        | some component =>
          match (component.operations.flatMap (fun operation ↦ operation.outputs)).find?
              (fun port ↦ decide (port.id = observation.port.port)) with
          | none => observation
          | some port => { observation with value :=
              ⟨.amount port.cell.2.2, m.world.state.balance port.cell⟩ }
      let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex refreshed
        (.invoke inv) m.world

mutations.name: drop-peer-supply
mutations.replacement:
((m.attempts.filter (fun attempt ↦ decide (attempt.branch = .left))).map
    (fun attempt ↦ attempt.supply d a)).sum

mutations.name: resurrect-revoked-capabilities
mutations.needle:
let outcome := executeStep cfg (boundaries b own.nextIndex) own.nextIndex own.outputs
        (.invoke inv) m.world
